name: Almond, in shell (as harvested)
source: Whole almond drupe (hull already removed at harvest, hard shell intact): illustrative proximate (per kg) water 90 g, protein 100 g, fat 250 g, carbohydrate 500 g (dominated by the woody shell), ash 60 g.
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Cracking (origin/nuts.ts) splits the in-shell nut's own exact composition between almond-kernel and almond-shell by splitByProfile.
